messages:
chloe_sales: Quick handoff  Opencast.ai signed for Dedicated pilot (3x A100) with EU data residency. Exec sponsor: Ingrid Holm (Head of Product). Target pilot launch 2024-06-20. Main risks: SSO cert window, corporate firewall for peering, and early precision issues on domain extraction. Adding @rafael_cs and @sam_eng as owners. :handshake:

rafael_cs: I can own the CSM. Will run kickoff and weekly check-ins. Need legal + billing contacts, and whether they require audit log export to their EU bucket. Also want success metrics from sales (latency target, extraction accuracy).

chloe_sales: Legal = contracts@opencast.ai, Billing = finance@opencast.ai. They want audit logs to EU S3 and 99.5% pilot SLA. I uploaded prompt pack and initial GT set to shared drive.

infra_bot: Created tickets CS-8245 "Opencast EU peering - network details" and ENG-6999 "Opencast SAML integration - triage". Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8245 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-6999

sam_eng: I'll triage ENG-6999. Need SAML metadata XML, SP entityID, cert expiry, and allowed CIDR ranges for peering. ETA for initial triage 48h. Can join kickoff to demo SSO test. Recommend auto-fallback to redwood-v1-7b during bursts and enable prefix caching for repeated system prompts.

pri_csm: Day-to-day CSM here. Please confirm model pin and pool sizing. Also request Eng/SE join a 25m slot in kickoff to review prompt engineering, cost per 1k tokens, and the eval plan for nightly regressions. We'll capture top-10 failure cases in week 1. @sam_eng

chloe_sales: Model pin = redwood-v2-13b-quant, initial pool 3xA100. Procurement contact is procurement@opencast.ai. Chloe will share final prompt set and labeled examples by EOD.

rafael_cs: Action items (draft): 1) Chloe to upload final prompt pack + labeled examples (PRIORITY) 2) Infra_bot tickets CS-8245 / ENG-6999 active 3) Sam to triage SAML/peering (ETA 48h) 4) Pri to schedule kickoff week of 6/17 and own feedback capture 5) Rafael to track weekly status and flag renewal risk if pilot metrics < agreed targets. Anything to add? :eyes:
